object.attr: analysis: the whole outline of a 5,000-object document was 1 MB, too much for an agent, and MCP clients cut or refuse long results (CF-M23). Set from the client's token cap, measured first (review Q10). This is the accepted reason to break MELLON-MCP-SRS-39 for the tools whose default result it shortens.
object.description: With default parameters, on a repository of TBD documents of 1,000 objects each, the MCP server should return each tool result in at most TBD characters of JSON text.
